verdict.rationale: Kintsugi's marketing claims it 'finds the exposure you didn't know you had, registers you, and files everywhere you sell,' and nexus lookback plus registration APIs support identifying past-due exposure and creating registrations, but there is no explicit mention of voluntary disclosure agreements (VDAs) or back-filing of historical periods to clean up past liability. missing for 10: explicit VDA program or negotiation support, back-filing of historical/past-due returns, penalty/interest abatement guidance, any case study or documentation describing remediation of already-accrued exposure rather than just prospective registration and filing.
